title: Justice Between Children in Love and Giving

text_simplified: Parents must treat their children with justice and equality, and not discriminate between them in love and giving. Differentiating between children leads to feelings of jealousy and hatred among them. The Prophet ﷺ urged justice between children even in kisses.
